entry.title: New: Resolution 719 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AWARDS A PUBLIC ACCESS, OPEN SPACE, AND NATURAL RESOURCES PRESERVATION MAINTENANCE FUND STEWARDSHIP GRANT TO KOHANAIKI ‘OHANA

Approves a grant of $41,400 to Kohanaiki ‘Ohana, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, to remove invasive plant species, re-establish native host plants and strand vegetation, and support coastal maintenance activities on O‘oma Beach, North Kona, property (Tax Map Key: 7-3-009:004), pursuant to Section 10-16(h) of the Hawaiʻi County Charter.
